dataList.place:
Passageway to Tiekan Temple
通往铁槛寺的走廊

dataList.content:
Aw, shit.
啊……妈的。

... That was a warning shot, sir.
……刚刚那是鸣枪示警。

... I heard you curse under your breath.
……你那小声咒骂可都被听见了。

They're...
他们是。

How disrespectful of you to tell such a bald-faced lie to your senior.
对上级之人说谎……有失礼仪。

Apologies. ... Please, I humbly beg for your assistance in my absolution.
是我失礼了。……能请你助我付出代价吗？

Of course. Present your tongue.
没问题。把舌头伸出来。

... Gah!
……咳啊！

... That incomprehensible exchange between the pair was soon followed by the sight of a severed tongue rolling in the dirt.
……一段难以理解的对话过后，其中一人被切下的舌头就已经在地上滚来滚去了。

... The Thumb.
……拇指。

Please allow me to speak, as my partner no longer has the means to do so.
她已经没了舌头……所以由我代言。

Your present company, including Manager Dante, their companions, and master Jia Baoyu, may not pass beyond this area.
但丁经理一行人。以及贾宝玉大人不可经过此处。

Uh... what did he just call Hong Lu...?
啊……称呼好像有点……

Given the present circumstances, they're treating Hong Lu as Baoyu of the Jia family and not a Sinner of the LCB.
因为看情况……他是被当作了贾家的宝玉，而不是LCB的罪人鸿璐。

It's logical to assume that the young master of a prestigious house ranks higher than a Soldato, who are just grunts of the Thumb.
显然……贾家少爷这一身份对应的阶级，比那个看起来像是拇指底层的士兵高得多。

W-well, can Hong Lu just ask him to move, then...?
那、那要是让他们让路的话……

... Them showin' us respect now don't mean shite. They won't let us through.
……没用的。那些家伙就算嘴上放尊重点，也不会对敌人手软的。

I've heard stories, but... I didn't think they'd be this fixated with the ranks and hierarchies. It's almost...
虽然是有听说过这回事……但他们真的对阶级或上下级差距非常执着。

... to the point where it's just plain weird.
……执着到一种诡异的程度。

Please understand that the underboss has ordered us to treat anyone passing this area as our enemy.
二老板有令，凡是经过这里的人一律当作敌人。

Our orders were to execute all individuals attempting to do so anyway, including our former allies. So I implore you to please turn around and leave this place.
不论是敌是友，一律处置。

We would greatly appreciate your cooperation.
请各位原路返回。

Um... sorry, we can't do that.
嗯……这有点困难呢。

Then... I'm sorry to say that we have no choice but to stop you by any means.
那么……我们也只能全力以赴了。

Lei Heng... he must've set up this ambush.
雷横……是那家伙设下了埋伏。

They were prepared... They weren't going to accept any other result than what they had in mind anyway.
既然他们打算这么亮相……那他们从一开始就没打算接受这个结果。

... Taking into account Limbus Company's standing, and LCB's position within their organization... you, a mere Sinner, mentioning master Lei Heng's name is a crime punishable by the removal of your tongue—
……考虑到边狱公司的等级……以及其LCB部门的地位……身为罪人的你敢直呼雷横大人的名号就该把舌头……不对。

... No. Your punishment will begin with crushing your lower jaw.
把下颚整个打碎也不够。

I.F. Shouldn't have expected a trivial little thing like a Soldato to know his place. You don't have enough tongues to lose for this disrespect.
懂·自·懂。区区士兵连自己的本分都搞不清楚。你就算有一百条舌头也不够用。

... We're not getting anything out of them.
……看来从他们这里，是得不到我们想要的答复了。

These idiots'll jump off a cliff if their superior told them to.
毕竟他们是只会听从上级命令不顾死活的蠢货。

But aren't they usually your favorite kind of people, Outis?
这不就是奥提斯女士最喜欢的群体吗？

There once was a time when I used to think highly of their strategic decision to maintain such a rigidly stratified hierarchy system.
我以前也有一阵子在战略上推崇过拇指的方式。

But now I know that it was never a strategic 'decision' at all, but a brainless obsession of idiots who refuse to decide for themselves.
当然，我现在也知道他们只是群没有判断力的蠢货。

... Let's see if you can keep babbling like that when we cut off your tongue.
……等你们付出代价之后，倒要看看你们还能不能继续口出狂言。
